summary: Verified the contention-start barrier on real GitHub with two genuinely distinct /wc workers. Both registered append-only no-authority entrant receipts before the deadline; one deterministic RELEASE listed both entrants and explicitly granted no execution authority; only after release did both race the same G000001 portfolio pin. This worker won and created the sole matching claim. The distinct second worker lost the same generation, persisted a valid prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 receipt naming the exact winner and next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION, and created no authoritative claim. The canary therefore closes the previous winner-only evidence gap without promoting the candidate into binding protocol or production /w.
tests: TWO_DISTINCT_ENTRANTS_PASS: WC-20260917T162316-0300-A7F3C2 and wc-20260917T1625-03-gpt56sol-a7f3 registered distinct entrant receipts.
RELEASE_PASS: exactly one RELEASE exists before deadline, lists both entrants and grants_execution_authority=false.
ONE_WINNER_PIN_PASS: exactly one G000001 winner exists after RELEASE.
WINNER_CLAIM_MATCH_PASS: claim directory contains only the matching winning claim.
REAL_LOSER_COLLISION_PASS: distinct loser receipt references the exact attempted/winning G000001 pin, winner worker/id, host_result=CREATE_EXISTS_OR_CAS_LOST and next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION.
NO_LOSER_CLAIM_PASS: no second authoritative claim exists.
NON_PROMOTION_PASS: candidate/barrier evidence does not by itself modify binding PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1 or make production /w operational.
unresolved: Independent integration is still required before the contention barrier becomes binding worker/portfolio protocol.
Live human-facing projection should be verified against this new entrant/release/collision evidence before claiming UI closure.

spawn_candidates.title: Integrate verified contention barrier into binding worker allocation protocol
spawn_candidates.reason: Isolated executable tests and a real two-worker GitHub canary now verify the barrier mechanism; integration should preserve authority boundaries and add a Live projection contract without silently promoting /w.
acceptance: Independent verifier replays committed test and real canary evidence.
Binding protocol changes preserve pin authority and mark entrant/release receipts as timing-only.
Allocator exposes barrier/rendezvous only for explicit multi-party canary jobs and normal jobs remain unchanged.
Live projection distinguishes WAITING_FOR_CONTENDERS, RELEASED_TO_RACE, winner, collision loser and timeout states.
No production /w promotion is inferred from integration.
